name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
note_long: Same flat style every time: mast and wing, board skimming the water. No propeller and no remote in any run; run 1 hangs a kite-style cable from the flipper instead.

note.en: Same flat style each time. Mast and wing; no motor, no remote.
note.ru: Каждый раз один плоский стиль. Мачта и крыло; ни мотора, ни пульта.
